$comment: Mutants no test can kill (issue 1269). Each entry names the project, file as the Stryker report spells it, mutator, line and replacement, and says why. A push whose changed files leave any other mutant surviving fails.

equivalents.reason: A React dependency list that is constant either way: an empty list and a list of one fixed string both run the hook once and never again, so no test can tell them apart.
